meta.method: Parallel web search/fetch; each email/phone cross-checked against the company site plus an independent directory/chamber/registry (SEVE, bizlist/GEMI, empresite, gasworld, IFAT, targeo, Türklim, egyptbusinessgate, industrychemistry, assorisorse, cavaexpotech, aquaenergyexpo). verified.email/phone = true only when 2 independent sources agree. No one was contacted. Nothing was committed.
meta.reach_note: Automated access to ECHA (echa.europa.eu, chem.echa.europa.eu) returned HTTP 403, so the REACH status shown is the company's own statement. Polyacrylamide polymers are exempt from registration, but a non-EU importer must cover the monomers (OR). Ask non-EU suppliers for the OR certificate and registration number.
meta.origin_note: Italian utilities (Art. 85 Directive 2014/25 / Art. 170 D.Lgs 36/2023): offers with >50% goods from third countries without an EU procurement-access agreement can be rejected. WTO-GPA parties (USA, Japan, UK, Switzerland, Israel, Korea) and EU/EEA count as safe; China/India do not. Turkey/Egypt/Morocco/Tunisia have customs-union or association agreements but NO procurement-access chapter, so confirm with the contracting entity before relying on them.
meta.sanctions_note: No Russia/Belarus/Iran companies included (Zirax RU and Falizan Tasfyeh IR were found and excluded). Not screened against OFAC/EU/UK lists automatically; run the final screen before signing.
not_found: No ISO-tank-capable FeCl2 producer was confirmed in Israel
No Turkish or Italian in-house PAM emulsion polymerizer was found (Turkish/Italian sellers resell SNF)
